Italian Football Trophies Collection – Ultra Realistic 3D Pack features a premium selection of Italian-style league and competition trophies designed for sports broadcasts, game cinematics, promotional content, and presentation scenes. Each model is built with clean topology, realistic proportions, and high-quality metallic materials to ensure strong reflections and professional visual impact in both close-up renders and wide showcase environments.
This pack contains:

  - Serie A

  - Coppa Italia

  - SuperCoppa Italiana

  - Serie B

  - Serie C

  - Coppa Federale

These models are ideal for stadium scenes, sports branding visuals, award ceremonies, and football-themed projects requiring authentic Italian competition-style trophies. Perfect for game developers, motion designers, and 3D artists looking for realistic and production-ready football silverware assets.

description_text:
The life size version is split into multiple parts to fit 256X256 mm print beds.
 It doesn't fit in the A1 mini bed. It's split it three parts: base, statue and globe. 
There are no mid-statue seams as in other similar models.

AMs is not necessary. Manual filament changes supported via pre-inserted pause points.
 I recommend using PLA Silk filament and dropping printing speed to 50% to achieve smooth and glossy surface.
Glue recommended for final assembly of the life size version

description_text:
Description:
High-quality, detailed 3D model of the iconic Adidas Jabulani Official Match Ball, used during the 2010 FIFA World Cup in South Africa.
This model has been accurately crafted in Blender to match the unique 8-panel spherical geometry, seamless surface design, and vibrant traditional South African color accents of the original match ball. Perfect for photorealistic renders, sports visualizations, animations, commercial projects, and real-time game engines.
Key Features:Accurate Geometry: Clean and optimized mesh based on the real-world dimensions and iconic panel layout of the Jabulani ball.
High-Resolution Textures: Includes crisp, high-detail texture maps for close-up renders.
PBR Ready: Surface textures configured for realistic light reflections, subtle gloss, and leather-like roughness.
Game & Render Optimized: Well-balanced polycount suitable for smooth performance in Unreal Engine, Unity, and offline rendering (Cycles / Eevee / V-Ray).
Clean UV Unwrapping: Non-overlapping UV layout ensures no texture stretching or seams issues.
Included File Formats:.blend (Native Blender project file with materials applied)
.fbx (Universal 3D exchange format)
.obj + .mtl (Wavefront standard format)
.gltf / .glb (Ideal for web, AR, and real-time platforms)
Technical Specifications:Object Type: Soccer / Football Match Ball

description_text:
This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00
The three residential highrises - 'Rudo' buildings or the Eastern gate of Belgrade are one of the most renowned buildings of the communist architecture in Yugoslavia. Built in 1976. on the hill, they mark the entrance to Belgrade from the Nis highway and the whole 'Konjarnik' residential neighborhood. With height of ~85m and 90m when looked from the lower level, they are among the tallest buildings in Belgrade and whole Balkans and with population of cca 500 each they are also among the most populated buildings in Balkans.

description_text:
Hey all! 
This is a clean mesh I've recently finished! It's fairly low poly looking despite having 40,000 + vertices, and is modeled after a real place (https://www.google.com/maps/@46.7868482,-92.0983326,3a,75y,287.7h,104.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm38GZl6fGHhAXFB-80vNmA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). This mesh can also be ported into other development environments. I've tried Cura, 3d paint, and Unity (as shown in the images). If you decide to import into Unity, know that the file labeled pixil-frame-1.png is your materials file. You should be able to click and drag it onto each object to color it. The pixil-frame-1.png is also my color palette that I used to model the buildings. I attached it separately so you can make more blender files with the same colors. if you choose to.
Thanks for checking out my project!

Cityscape Teaset

  - 16.6k polys.

  - Low-Poly, High-Quality Model.

  - Clean Geometry and Topology.

  - High-quality 4k textures (png). Includes:

  - Diffuse.

  - Roughness.

  - PBR shading.

  - Optimized to be rendered realistically in Cycles [ray-tracing] and Eevee [real-time].

  - Provided in:

  - AutoCAD FBX 2018 (.fbx),

  - Stanford (.ply), 

  - X3D Extensible 3D (.x3d),

  - Stl (.stl),

  - Alembic (.abc),

  - AutoCAD DXF 2018 (.dxf),

  - Universal Scene Description (.usdc),

  - Native Blender 3.1 file (.blend). 

Note: All Renders were done in Ray-tracing Cycles.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Suffren Class Cruiser model. Certain elements not to scale.
There were four Suffren-class heavy cruisers built by the French in the late '20's. They featured eight eight-inch guns as their primary armament, along with eight 3.5-inch guns, other smaller antiaircraft armament, and six torpedo tubes. Three were scuttled in 1942, with one being raised by the Italians and sunk by allied bombers in 1944. The lead-ship, Suffren, was not scuttled; instead it was disarmed and interned in Egypt in 1940 and brought back into service in 1943. It was scrapped in 1947.
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Update 29 Oct 19: Added boats and anchor chains. Adjustments for better printability.
Tested with PLA at .1mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Agano Class Cruiser model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Agano-class cruisers were a series of warships built for the Imperial Japanese Navy before WWII.  They carried six six-inch guns and eight torpedo tubes along with a collection of smaller armament.
This model is designed and tested at 1/1800th scale, but up-scaling and down-scaling are possible. Since the model is optimized for 1/1800th scale, it is not ideal to print larger versions due to a lack of detail. The gun barrels and mast have been enlarged
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.

Tested with PLA at .08mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Cruiser Oyodo model. Certain elements not to scale.
The light cruiser Oyodo was meant to be the lead ship of her class, but production was cancelled on the other ships. She carried six six-inch guns in two triple mounts and some smaller armament. She was sunk in July 1945.
This model is designed and tested at 1/1800th scale, but up-scaling and down-scaling are possible. Since the model is optimized for 1/1800th scale, it is not ideal to print larger versions due to a lack of detail. The gun barrels and mast have been enlarged.
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Update 07 Aug 19: Added boats and anchor chains. 
Tested with PLA at .08mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Perth Class Cruiser model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Perth class were the Amphion group of the Leander-class cruisers built and sold to the Australian Navy. Their primary armament were four twin six-inch guns and various secondary armament and torpedo tubes.
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Tested with PLA at .1mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

HISTORICAL NOTE: HMS Agincourt was a battleship built in the United Kingdom in the early 1910s. Originally part of an order from the Brazilian government, it has the distinction of assembling more heavy cannons (fourteen) and more towers (seven) than any other battleship, dreadnought, according to the request of Brazilians.
Brazil ordered the ship in 1911 as Rio de Janeiro from the British company Armstrong Whitworth. However, the collapse of the rubber boom in Brazil, led to the sale of the ship under construction to the Ottoman Empire in 1913. The Ottomans renamed their name Sultan Osman I, in honor of the founder of the empire, and the ship was almost ready when World War I broke out. The British government seized it for use by the Royal Navy, along with another Ottoman battleship being built in Britain. Renamed Agincourt by the Royal Navy, she joined the Great Fleet in the North Sea. During the war, he participated in the Battle of Jutland in 1916. Agincourt was placed in reserve in 1919 and sold as scrap in 1922 to comply with the terms of the Washington Naval Treaty.
Additional note: The length of the ship and the huge number of 305mm cannons have always caused huge skepticism in the Royal Navy about the ship's ability to shoot sideways (with all cannons at the same time) without causing structural damage; these doubts were dispelled during the Battle of Jutland, during which the ship fired 144 shots, 84 of which against side fire, silencing its detractors. During this battle, the only one that saw her employed, the ship reported no damage and her crew did not report any deaths or injuries.

description_text:
The Capitolium or Capitoline Hill , between the Forum and the Campus Martius, is one of the Seven Hills of Rome.
The hill was earlier known as Mons Saturnius, dedicated to the god Saturn. The word Capitolium first meant the temple of Jupiter Optimus Maximus later built here, and afterwards it was used for the whole hill (and even other temples of Jupiter on other hills), thus Mons Capitolinus (the adjective noun of Capitolium). In an etiological myth, ancient sources connect the name to caput (head, summit) and the tale was that, when laying the foundations for the temple, the head of a man was found,[3] some sources even saying it was the head of some Tolus or Olus. The Capitolium was regarded by the Romans as indestructible, and was adopted as a symbol of eternity.
By the 16th century, Capitolinus had become Capitolino in Italian, and Capitolium Campidoglio. The Capitoline Hill contains few ancient ground-level ruins, as they are almost entirely covered up by Medieval and Renaissance palazzi (now housing the Capitoline Museums) that surround a piazza, a significant urban plan designed by Michelangelo.
The word Capitolium still lives in the English word capitol, and Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C. is widely assumed to be named after the Capitoline Hill.
Mixed photogrammetry and modeling

description_text:
This is the Mark I GP 250 lb bomb used by the Britain on multiple types of aircraft, from bombers to fighters, such as the Wellington or Typhoon. There are 6 different versions of the GP 250lb. It weighs 247 pounds, with an explosive mass of 68 pounds of T.N.T. or 63 pounds of Amatol 80/20. It has a diameter of 10.3 inches, and a total length of 54.2 inches. A bomb with a time delay fuse has red fins, and this model comes with textures for bombs with or without a time delay fuse.
The plugin used is Armory 3D, used to render the PBR images you see. The information in the description can be found in British Explosive Ordnance, published by Navy Department Bureau of Ordnance on June 10, 1946.

description_text:
https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belek_GaziBelek Gazi, (Balak ya da Balağ olarak da bilinir, tam adı Nürü'd-Devle Belek bin Behram bin Artuk, ö. 5 Mayıs 1124, Münbiç), Selçukluların Harput, Dersim, Halep ve Genc emiri olan Türkmen komutan. Bugün dahi adı hala Elâzığ'da sık sık anılarak yad edilen, dönemin Harput Emir'i ve Türk Orduları Başkumandanı'dır. Harput Türkmenlerinin, Gakgoşların atasıdır. Belek Gazi, Haçlılara karşı imha edici muharebelerle büyük zaferler kazanan, Anadolu'nun Türkleşmesinde büyük rol oynayan, kahramanlığı ile nam salmış, adil ve şefkatli bir Türk fatihiydi. Belek Gazi kendi döneminde gelişen Haçlı Seferlerine karşı büyük başarılar göstermiş, 1122 yılında Urfa kontu I. Joselin'i, 1123'te ise onu kurtarmaya gelen Kudüs Kralı II. Baudouin'i esir ederek zincire vurmuş ve ikisini de Harput kalesinde hapsetmiştir. Bu üstün başarıları üzerine Büyük Selçuk Sultanı tarafından Türk Orduları Başkumandanı tayin edilmiştir. Kendisine Gazi unvanı verilmiştir. Belek Gazi 1124 yılında ise Menbiç kalesini kuşatırken göğsüne isabet eden bir okla ölmüştür. Onun ölümü Müslümanların duraklamasına ve Haçlıların ise bir süre yükselişine sebep olsa da Belek Gazi'nin ölümünden 14 yıl sonra doğan, yine bir Selçuklu Emiri olan ve Haçlılara karşı büyük başarıları devam ettiren Selahattin Eyyubi çıkıvermiştir. Belek Gazi ile Selahattin Eyyubi yakın zamanlarda yaşadıklarından ve ikisi de Selçuklu Emirleri olduklarından ötürü dönemin ahalisi tarafından da sıkça mukayeseye tabii tutulmuşlardır.
Belek Gazi’den sonra 1185 yılına kadar Harput’ta yine Artukoğulları'ndan gelen Prensler, hüküm sürmüşlerdir. Bunlardan Fahrettin Kakmnj!raaslan’ında Harput tarihinde unutulmaz yeri ve eserleri vardır. 1148-1174 yılları arasında Harput’ta hüküm sürmüş ve burada bulunan Ulu Cami'yi yaptırmıştır. Tarihçi Profesör Halil Yinanç, Belek Gazi'den övgüyle bahsetmekte ve onun hakkında şunları demektedir: "Belek Gazi bütün ömrünü gaza ve cihad içinde geçirmiş, ülkesinde emsalsiz bir sükun ve asayiş temin etmiş, adalet ve kanunu hakim kılmış, dindar ve mütevazı bir emir idi. Ölümü, Müslümanlık ve Türklük için hakiki bir ziya ve musibet olmuş ve mağlup olmaya başlayan Haçlıların yeniden kalkınmalarına sebebiyet vermiştir. Haçlılar böyle korkunç ve galip bir düşmandan kurtuldukları için çok sevinmişlerdi.[

description_text:
A kettle hat, also known as a war hat, is a type of helmet made of iron or steel in the shape of a brimmed hat. There are many design variations. The only common element is a wide brim that afforded extra protection to the wearer. It gained its common English language name from its resemblance to a metal cooking pot (the original meaning of kettle). The kettle hat was common all over Medieval Europe. It was called Eisenhut in German and chapel de fer in French (both names mean iron hat in English)Historically accurate game ready asset modeled in Blender. High quality PBR material packed in just Diffuse/Metallic/Roughness/Normal_OpenGL textures available at 4k 2k and 1k resolution made in Substance Painter. Low Poly geometry. Obj, Fbx and .blend file. Buddha prayer beads bracelet means Harmony and Happiness. Dance with all different souls, and be ready to embrace more harmony and happiness. Buddha bead bracelet made of various natural stones and elements could help us recognize and respect differences in this universe.
gold
The colour of gold is important in the Buddhist mysticism. Laughing Buddha statues- symbolizing happiness and good health- are usually painted gold. Given its association with Sun, gold in Buddhism stands for knowledge, enlightenment, purity, happiness, and freedom.
Copper
Spiritual Properties
According to mythology, copper has the ability to conduct spiritual energy back and forth between individuals, crystals, auras, the mind and the spirit world. It is also used for its healing properties in improving circulation of blood, increasing energy and detoxification of the body.
Silver
Its faultless whiteness has made it a symbol of purity and of chastity. Purified in the refiner’s fire, it becomes a symbol of purification and perfection. Associated with its silvery counterpart in the night sky, it is integrated into an entire complex of lunar symbolism that includes the great purifier, water. Silver is representative of moon energy and is the balance between black and white. It is the color of the Greek goddess Artemis (Roman aspect: Diana). It is symbolic of purity, strength, clarity, focus, and the feminine energy.

Im re-selling these (actual real) Lanterns in my local town, so i decided to make a little model to have for advertising purposes (and as practice.)They are quite simple, no big deal. But, as i use to upload, it could be a nice space filler, or decoration, for a project. Also i haven't seen them on this plataform yet.As always, any constructive feedback is more than welcome.
Details:
Made with Blender 2.90.1 Rendered with Cycles. Last Picture in the Preview is the REAL LIFE reference for the model.

  - low-poly(1700 each piece)

  - Subdivition ready

  - 4sizes 

  - Different loose parts joined together (not a single continuous mesh)

  - The blend file comes with 4 procedural materials (cycles only) shown in the preview    -Rusty metal    -Metal    -Dusty shattered glass     -Glass

  - Formats: .Blend, .OBJ, .FBX, files

Admigual

description_text:
[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc 

  - The model was originally modeled in Maya 2020 and rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale

[GENERAL]

  - PBR Materials

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Object Height: 157cm

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Polygons: 152

  - Tris: 296

  - Verts: 184

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for PBR Metallic Roughness, Unreal Engine, Unity, Arnold, V-Ray, Spark AR Studio, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell and more.
[TEXTURES]

  - Textures Formats: PNG

  - Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.

-------------(2K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(2048x2048)

  - Base Color(2048x2048)

  - Metallic(2048x2048)

  - Roughness(2048x2048)

  - Ambient Occlusion(2048x2048)

-------------(4K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(4096 x 4096)

  - Base Color(4096 x 4096)

  - Metallic(4096 x 4096)

  - Roughness(4096 x 4096)

  - Ambient Occlusion(4096 x 4096)

-------------(8K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(8192x8192)

  - Base Color(8192x8192)

  - Metallic(8192x8192)

  - Roughness(8192x8192)

  - Ambient Occlusion(8192x8192)

[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc 

  - The model was originally modeled in Maya 2020 and rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale

[GENERAL]

  - PBR Materials

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Object Height: 240cm

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Polygons: 124

  - Tris: 244

  - Verts: 146

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for PBR Metallic Roughness, Unreal Engine, Unity, Arnold, V-Ray, Spark AR Studio, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell and more.
[TEXTURES]

  - Textures Formats: PNG

  - Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.

-------------(2K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(2048x2048)

  - Base Color(2048x2048)

  - Metallic(2048x2048)

  - Roughness(2048x2048)

  - Ambient Occlusion(2048x2048)

-------------(4K)----------------------

  - Base Color(4096 x 4096)

-------------(8K)----------------------

  - Base Color(8192x8192)

  - Metallic(8192x8192)

  - Roughness(8192x8192)

  - Ambient Occlusion(8192x8192)

[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Tris: 244

description_text:
[USAGE] 

  - This model is suitable for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Movies/Film, Interior/Exterior design, etc 

  - The model was originally modeled in Maya 2020 and rendered with Marmoset Toolbag 4

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale

[GENERAL]

  - PBR Materials

  - Game Ready model

  - Low Poly mesh

  - High Poly mesh baked on Low Poly mesh

  - Object pivot points at 0,0,0

  - Object scaled to approximate real world size (cm)

  - Object Height: 121cm

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied

  - Triangulate mesh and Quad both are included in folder

  - Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192

[3D Model File Formats]

  - .Ma + .Mb + .Max

  - .3DS + .Fbx + .Obj + .dae + .Abc

  - .unitypackage + .uasset

  - .glTF + .glb + .USD + .USDZ

[GEOMETRY]

  - Polygons: 55

  - Tris: 110

  - Verts: 72

High resolution textures exported out of Substance Painter for PBR Metallic Roughness, Unreal Engine, Unity, Arnold, V-Ray, Spark AR Studio, Renderman, Redshift, KeyShot, Maxwell and more.
[TEXTURES]

  - Textures Formats: PNG

  - Includes 2 Set textures map(Clean, Dirty) with Texture Dimension 2048x2048, 4096x4096 and 8192x8192.

-------------(2K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(2048x2048)

  - Base Color(2048x2048)

  - Metallic(2048x2048)

  - Roughness(2048x2048)

  - Ambient Occlusion(2048x2048)

-------------(4K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(4096 x 4096)

  - Base Color(4096 x 4096)

  - Metallic(4096 x 4096)

  - Roughness(4096 x 4096)

  - Ambient Occlusion(4096 x 4096)

-------------(8K)----------------------

  - Normal Map DirectX & OpenGL(8192x8192)

  - Base Color(8192x8192)

  - Metallic(8192x8192)

  - Roughness(8192x8192)

  - Ambient Occlusion(8192x8192)

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.
Features:

  - One model, 4 texture packs.

  - Clean topology and only quads.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

  - All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.

  - Preview renders were made in: Substain Painter and MarmosetToolbag.

  - All the objects of the model are named.

  - One UVW.

4xTextures:

  - Material Base Color, Height, Metallic, Mixed AO, Normal, Roughness.

  - Resolution: 4096x4096.

File Formats:
.max:

  - 3ds Max 2018 +Corona Render.

  - 3ds Max 2017 +Corona Render.

  - 3ds Max 2016 +Corona Render.

  - 3ds Max 2015 +Corona Render.

.obj:

  - OBJ for 3Ds max (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for Blender (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for C4D (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for Maya (MultiFormat).

  - OBJ for ZBrush (MultiFormat).

Other:

  - 3DS.

  - Textures (.rar and .zip).

Polygons and Vertices:

  - Polygons: 204.

  - Vertices: 208.

description_text:
Hi friends,
here is my new project for WWII wargaming tables.It is a huge steel bridge in 28/35 mm scale. The bridge is nicely detailed and has sidewalks on the sides. For the surface, I recommend a layer of modeling compound and using a roller to shape the surface, for example.The size is 70 cm long, 35 cm wide and 15 cm high at the highest point.But don't worry, the bridge is divided into parts so that it can be printed on a 20x20cm printing surface.Printing is simple and completely support-free. The entire bridge is a large kit that is connected using M3 screws (the list of connecting material is part of the files).1 kg of filament was needed for printing, it depends on the settings. The bridge is really strong and can be used as a bridge.The bridge can be divided into two halves for portability and storage.When you go to play, you screw in 8 screws and you can play.I printed from PLA, but it's no problem to use PETG. The parts do not contain any supports or large bridging.Enjoy my work and liven up your gaming table with a really nice piece of terrain.
Have a nice day, Lukas

Overview: This model is a 3D representation of standard shipping pallets, ideal for enhancing realism in various 3D projects. The 3D model is based on EPAL euro pallets. Model made in Blender, textures made in Substance Designer and Substance Painter. Rendered in Blender using EEVEE and Cycles. The textures are packed into the .fbx and .glb files for seamless integration into your scenes.
Technical Specifications:
Software and Tools:

  - Model created in Blender

  - Textures generated in Substance Designer and Substance Painter

  - Rendering achieved using Blender's EEVEE and Cycles engines

  - Textures packed into .fbx and .glb files for seamless integration

File Formats:
  - .fbx, .glb, .obj, .stl, .blend
Textures:

  - Textures available in .jpg format

  - Resolution options: 8k, 4k, 2k, and 1k

Model Details:

  - Accurate representation of standard wooden pallets used in shipping and logistics.

  - Detailed surface textures mimic wood grain and imperfections.

  - Realistic wear and tear, including scratches, dents, and weathering effects.

Compatibility:

  - Compatible with leading 3D modeling and rendering software.

  - Suitable for use in various platforms and game engines.

Applications:

  - Gaming Environments: Create immersive gaming environments with authentic industrial structures.

  - Industrial Simulations: Simulate realistic industrial settings for training and educational purposes.

  - CGI Production: Incorporate realistic props into CGI scenes for film, animation, and virtual reality projects.

3D model of a Barrel bundle with PBR textures, ensuring high fidelity and realism. This low poly, game-ready asset has been designed with attention to detail, offering an optimal blend of quality and performance for various applications.

High-Quality Texturing: Textured meticulously in Substance Painter to achieve lifelike materials and surfaces.
Render Ready: All preview renders are generated in Unreal Engine, showcasing the model in a realistic setting.
Custom Branding: All branding and labels are custom-created, providing unique and distinct visual elements.
Inclusion: Model is provided as seen in renders, complete with all associated assets and textures.

Formats Included:
OBJ: Universal format compatible with most 3D software.
FBX: For seamless import into game engines and 3D software.
STL: Suitable for 3D printing applications.
Usage:This versatile model is suited for a wide range of applications, from gaming environments and personal projects to commercial productions. The asset can be integrated into any game engine or 3D project, enhancing the visual fidelity and immersion of your digital creations.
License Agreement:Upon purchase, you are granted the right to use this model in any game, personal project, or commercial product. Redistribution, resale, or repurposing of the model or its textures in any form is strictly prohibited, ensuring exclusivity for your project.
Support and Customization:We pride ourselves on customer satisfaction and are here to assist with any questions or support you may need. Customization requests, including texture adjustments or format conversions, are welcome to ensure the asset fits perfectly into your project.

description_text:
Stylized Cartoony Lighthouse 3d model made in 3ds Max 2022 and textured in Substance Painter. No plugins/addons were used.
Model details:

  - Every model part is named properly, model is centered to the middle of its bottom part and placed to 0.0.0 scene coordinates

  - Model has 9158 polygons and 9535 vertices

  - Lighthouse is unwrapped to a single 4k UV map, landscape is unwrapped to a different 4k UV map

  - Renders are made in Substance Painter Iray renderer, textures were rendered in 4k reso 

  - Model pack includes .fbx, .max, .obj, .blend files, textures are not embedded and have to be plugged in manually!

  - FBX files are provided for 2014/2015, 2016/2017 and 2020 versions

  - Textures pack includes Arnold, Corona, Unity hd and Vray .png 4k textures, as well as 4k .png, .jpeg and .targa UE4 textures

  - Railing connectors, ladder stairs and ladder sides share same UVs

  - Nothing is animated

  - Weighted normals are applied

  - You might want to rescale model

  - Building is hollow, there are no interiors

As usual - best wishes & have a nice day!

Low Poly model of a japanese Torii.
My insipiration was the Itsukushima shrine Torii.It was made using Blender, Substance Painter and Adobe Photoshop.
It’s gameready with roughly 3.6k triangles and 1.9k vertices.The maps are all PBR 4k (with an 8k AO): Normal, Base Color, Roughness, AO, Height and Metallic
If you enjoy this Model please some feedback in the comments!
A torii (Japanese: 鳥居, [to.ɾi.i]) is a traditional Japanese gate most commonly found at the entrance of or within a Shinto shrine, where it symbolically marks the transition from the mundane to the sacred.The presence of a torii at the entrance is usually the simplest way to identify Shinto shrines, and a small torii icon represents them on Japanese road maps.https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torii

description_text:
As seen in the Classic 1960's George Pal film The Time Machine, this is a model of the dedication monument with the inscribed plaquethat George reads when he arrives into London 1966.
This model has been designed to be printed in the following options:
Resin printed (as a single part)or in PLA (as two separate parts).  The model is hollowed out to help reduce the amount of material neeeded.
The model is scaled at 1/6th and can be reduced or enlarged to fit any size printer.  I have tested both the resin and PLA versions of the design and there have been no issues with either print.

description_text:
This listing is for the Large Version of the Love For Paris Light Up Diorama. The Mini version is also listed and a bundle for both is listed that saves you 25%.
File consists of:

  - 3 models; The Diorama Insert, Outer Shell, & Base. Each one comes in STL, OBJ, and FBX formats

  - Studio Quality Sample images

  - Buyer's Guide which has links to the lights that fit inside it (just little puck lights you twist to turn on. Nothing fancy.), the paint I used, and screws to use for the mini version.

The Large version is easily put together. Everything just slides together and you're done. Designed to be printed with Resin printers but can be printed with FDM printers as well, although I can't promise you'll get the same great details as you would with resin, like the top of the Eiffel Tower, small bushes, or Paris engraving on the front. For resin printers, everything has been designed where it doesn't need any supports if printed upright. Same might be possible with FDM printers because the overhangs are very small (Although the arch at the very top might need some). I print the diorama insert piece in clear resin and don't hollow it out. It's a solid piece. I found it looked better that way. Then I print the shell and base in white and spray paint them.
Dimensions when fully assembled:
Height: 127mm (5in)
Length: 101.6mm (4in)
Width: 101.6mm (4in)
Prior to me losing my ability to print, I was able to sell these at $25 for the minis and $70 for the larges.If you plan to sell these, feel free to use the studio quality sample pictures included for your listing :) And if you have any issues, you can shoot me an email at ForgedRealites@gmail.com
